title: Frankl’s Union-Closed Sets conjecture
statement: Frankl’s Union-Closed Sets conjecture · December 1979. Every finite union-closed family containing at least one nonempty set has an element contained in at least half its sets.

counterexample.description: A counterexample is such a union-closed bitset family in which every element occurs in fewer than half the sets. Closure, nontriviality, and frequencies are directly checked.
